evidence: src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx:71-76 blocks handleSend when sourceListStatus is loading/partial/error; src/stores/sourceStore.ts:23-30 already returns SourceScope {kind:none} for those statuses.
root_cause: Retrieval/source-list readiness is treated as a hard precondition for chat even though a no-retrieval fallback exists.
fix: Remove sourceListStatus from hard send/input disable path. Let getSourceScope() degrade to {kind:"none"}. Display a non-blocking warning: Source context unavailable; asking model without retrieval.
validation: Frontend test/static gate: with sourceListStatus=error and non-empty input, send button enabled and sendMessage called with SourceScope kind none.

evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs:2401-2425 GPU gate Ok(None) returns without chat:done/chat:error; 2456-2469 LLM gate Ok(None) same; 2630-2662 suppresses CHAT_CANCELLED_NOTEBOOK_SWITCH errors.
root_cause: Cancellation/notebook-switch paths record traces but do not emit a terminal event that the UI can use to clear streaming state.
fix: Introduce one terminalization helper for spawned task exits. Every exit must emit exactly one of chat:done, chat:error, or chat:cancelled; frontend must clear streaming on all terminal event types.
validation: Static gate: no `return;` in spawned stream task after streaming state starts unless immediately preceded by terminal event emission. Unit/integration test for notebook-switch cancellation clears isStreaming.

evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs:2511-2518 emits chat:done after active notebook switch and before assistant persistence; 2556-2569 logs DB insert failure but still continues to evidence/done.
root_cause: Completion event is emitted even when assistant message is not durably persisted.
fix: Do not emit chat:done unless persistence succeeded or a typed PartialGenerationReceipt/CancellationReceipt exists. DB insert failure must emit chat:error or chat:partial_saved_failure and clear UI as error, not done.
validation: Mock DB insert failure test: backend emits chat:error, not done; assistant_persisted=false; UI clears streaming and displays recoverable partial output.

evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs:3216-3288 creates GenerationReceiptV1 with partial_persisted true inside stream_chat_response before the outer DB insert path proves assistant persistence.
root_cause: Receipt semantics are ahead of actual durable persistence.
fix: Split provider-stream receipt from assistant-persistence receipt. Only mark assistant_persisted/partial_persisted after NotebookDb insert succeeds; otherwise record unpersisted_partial with recovery data.
validation: Receipt schema test: stream completion without DB insert cannot produce assistant_persisted=true or partial_persisted=true.

evidence: src/stores/chatStore.ts:184-203 clears local stream and says partial output was not saved; src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs:859-865 stop_chat only bumps active_epoch.
root_cause: Stop is frontend-local state mutation plus backend epoch bump, not a durable cancellation handshake.
fix: Add backend cancellation receipt/terminal event. UI should wait for terminal cancellation event or display pending cancellation state with timeout fallback.
validation: Stop button test: backend emits cancellation event; frontend clears streaming only after event or records timeout fallback; no contradiction between UI message and backend persistence.

evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs:3615-3624 tests provider_done_terminal_decision only; it does not run a fake provider stream through backend/UI.
root_cause: The previous done-frame fix has marker-level tests, not end-to-end behavioral proof.
fix: Add fake provider stream test: token frame -> done=true frame -> no EOF -> backend emits terminal event -> UI finalizes and persists assistant.
validation: Test fails if backend waits for EOF or UI remains streaming after done frame.

evidence: src/App.tsx:54-56 drops chat:token if payload.notebook_id != activeNotebookId; 78-80 drops chat:status; 87-90 drops chat:error; 107-109 drops chat:evidence.
root_cause: Event routing uses the currently viewed notebook as the authority for terminal stream lifecycle, but an in-flight stream has its own message/notebook identity.
fix: Route terminal events to chatStore first. chatStore should ignore only if payload does not match streamingNotebookId/streamingMessageId. ActiveNotebook filtering can govern display/toasts, not stream cleanup.
validation: Unit test: switch active notebook after send; backend emits done/error for original notebook; isStreaming clears and no orphan spinner remains.

evidence: src/stores/chatStore.ts:152-169 returns after backend invoke if localStorage active notebook or activeConversation mismatch, without clearing streaming.
root_cause: Frontend assumes later events will clean up even when it has already decided the active context no longer matches.
fix: On mismatch, either preserve stream under a stream manager independent of active conversation or explicitly clear/transfer streaming state and mark it detached.
validation: Test activeConversation changes while invoke is in-flight: no lingering isStreaming true.

evidence: src/stores/chatStore.ts:310-324 resetForNotebookSwitch preserves streaming state while src/App.tsx activeNotebook filters can drop future events.
root_cause: Notebook switching policy is split across store and App listener filters.
fix: Centralize active-stream identity and event routing. Preserve stream if desired, but terminal event must always reach stream owner.
validation: E2E: start chat, switch notebook, wait for backend cancellation/done; UI for original/active notebook does not remain spinner-only.

evidence: src/stores/sourceStore.ts:511-530 can set sourceListStatus partial/error based on stats/source mismatch, and ChatPanel currently turns that into hard send-disable.
root_cause: Index/stats drift becomes a chat availability failure.
fix: Keep partial/error as retrieval warning only. Add DB doctor/index refresh CTA, not chat disable.
validation: Source stats mismatch fixture: chat still sends with no retrieval; UI shows source warning.

evidence: src/lib/tauri.ts exposes debugChatProviderSmoke/getLastChatAttemptTrace, but SettingsDialog:683-696 only says ChatAttemptTraceV1 is backend-owned.
root_cause: Existing diagnostic primitives are not exposed to the operator at the point of failure.
fix: Add buttons: Run Ollama provider smoke, Copy last ChatAttemptTraceV1, Copy redacted provider config summary.
validation: Manual/UI smoke: click provider smoke, result includes phase/provider/base URL class/first_token_seen/done_seen/assistant_persisted/error.

evidence: src-tauri/src/providers/mod.rs:14 only lists localhost/127.0.0.1/::1; 178-184 restricts Ollama/LlamaCpp to loopback; 536-551 tests LAN URL rejection.
root_cause: Gloss supports only loopback local providers despite common operator topology where Ollama runs on LAN host.
fix: Do not silently allow all LAN. Add explicit allow_lan_local_providers setting, default false; allow RFC1918/private LAN only when enabled; still reject public IP, credentials, query, fragment.
validation: Provider tests: loopback allowed by default; LAN rejected by default; LAN accepted with opt-in; public/credential/query/fragment URLs rejected.

evidence: src/stores/settingsStore.ts:31/40 defaults to qwen3:8b; src-tauri/src/db/migrations.rs:72-73 seeds default_model qwen3:8b; provider registry requires selected model to exist.
root_cause: Default model can be stale/missing for a user’s Ollama instance; chat then fails before request.
fix: On model refresh/provider save, verify default_model exists. If absent, auto-select first compatible Ollama model only with user-visible notice, or block with explicit model-selection error.
validation: Fixture with no qwen3:8b but one Ollama model: Settings prompts/selects valid model; chat smoke uses selected model.

evidence: SettingsDialog ProviderSection:146-156 calls testProvider and reports reachable; it does not invoke /api/chat with selected model.
root_cause: Connectivity health check is being conflated with chat readiness.
fix: Separate Provider Reachable from Chat Smoke. Chat smoke must call debug_chat_provider_smoke with selected model and prompt.
validation: UI shows both base connectivity and selected-model chat smoke result; failure includes trace phase.

evidence: SettingsDialog handleProviderSave:361-380 updates provider and loadSettings but does not refresh model registry.
root_cause: Provider URL changes can leave model registry/default model stale.
fix: After provider save, run refreshModels or mark models stale and require refresh before chat smoke/send.
validation: Changing Ollama URL updates models/default model state before chat can be sent.

evidence: src-tauri/src/providers/ollama.rs:173-220 streams via llm_pipeline::StreamingDecoder; observed decoder silently ignores invalid JSON lines in Libraries/llm-pipeline.
root_cause: Malformed provider frames can be dropped, delaying first-token/done diagnosis.
fix: Make streaming decoder emit bounded decode error with chunk digest/line count after malformed frame threshold; do not silently ignore all invalid frames.
validation: Malformed NDJSON fixture produces provider_stream_decode_error, not spinner/empty response.

evidence: NotebookDb::insert_message does not insert created_at, relying on DB default, but chat path emits done even if insert_message fails.
root_cause: Persistence failure is not treated as terminal failure.
fix: Treat assistant insert failure as chat:error and persist partial/error artifact if possible. Never emit success done without durable assistant or explicit partial failure receipt.
validation: DB failure fixture; final UI state shows error and partial recovery, not successful assistant message.

evidence: scripts/audit_chat_path_integration.py failed: missing GlossLocalMemoryBackend::new, allow_fallback:true, raw-content-text-fallback, backend_used tracking/order.
root_cause: Active chat retrieval path does not satisfy the project’s own static integration contract, or the contract script is stale. Either way, the gate is not reliable green proof.
fix: Inspect actual retrieval path and update code or gate. Track requested backend and actual backend_used distinctly; prove fallback order and evidence disclosure.
validation: audit_chat_path_integration.py passes after source-backed fix; retrieval fixture verifies backend_used/source disclosure.

evidence: scripts/audit_retrieval_disclosures.py --latest returned no_receipts / no retrieval disclosure receipt found.
root_cause: The latest run lacks a current retrieval disclosure receipt, or the validator cannot find it.
fix: Write RetrievalDisclosureReceiptV1 for latest chat/retrieval flows; update validator to locate current run consistently.
validation: audit_retrieval_disclosures.py --latest returns ok and cites latest receipt path.

evidence: chatStore on error keeps streamingContent but does not create durable assistant/partial message.
root_cause: Partial-generation recovery is UI-local, not durable/reloadable.
fix: On backend error with partial content, persist PartialGenerationReceipt and expose recovery action to save/discard partial.
validation: Timeout/error fixture with partial tokens survives reload or is explicitly marked non-recoverable.

evidence: Backend emits evidence and done after assistant insertion attempt, but insert failure path only warns and can still emit done/evidence.
root_cause: Evidence/terminal events are not gated on persistence success.
fix: Gate evidence and done on persistence; if evidence generation succeeds but message persistence fails, write evidence to failed-partial artifact and emit error.
validation: DB failure + evidence fixture proves no orphan evidence attached to nonexistent assistant.

evidence: FINAL_RECEIPT.json says release_candidate_gate_passed=true; RELEASE_CANDIDATE_GATE_RESULTS.json says release_candidate_gate_passed=false and shows package scope gate failed.
root_cause: Final receipt promoted a false pass despite aggregate gate failure.
fix: Generate final receipt from gate results, not independent prose. Add cross-check: final release_candidate_gate_passed must equal RELEASE_CANDIDATE_GATE_RESULTS value.
validation: Validator fails if final receipt contradicts gate result.

evidence: Report/findings warn run_all_checks references validation/gloss_secret_store_permissions_gate.py but file is excluded as secret-like-filename.
root_cause: Packager secret-like filename policy excludes an active validation script, breaking fresh replay.
fix: Rename script to non-secret filename or teach packager allowlist for validation script path with content redaction check. run_all_checks must reference included files only.
validation: Fresh unzip: run_all_checks does not reference any missing path; package report has no script-ref-not-archived.

evidence: gloss_package_scope_gate.py fails/no package manifest found in current extract; current run gate result also failed because manifest included 50 top-level paths outside Gloss/Libraries.
root_cause: Context package is rooted at /Coding and includes unrelated root files, not a clean Gloss package boundary.
fix: Produce separate artifacts: Codex context pack may include selected Libraries; release/source package must be rooted at Gloss only with explicit external dependency manifest.
validation: gloss_package_scope_gate.py passes in fresh unzip and rejects unrelated top-level files.

evidence: Codex archive sidecar reports current_run P30 while CURRENT_RUN files report GLOSS_TOTAL_COMPLETION_AND_HARDENING_SUPERPASS_20260526.
root_cause: Multiple current-run truth surfaces are not reconciled during packaging.
fix: Define one CurrentRunTruthV1 source and have sidecars/project docs project from it. Gate all mismatches.
validation: current run truth gate checks CURRENT_RUN, docs/CURRENT_RUN, codex-archive, final receipt, package metadata.

evidence: gloss_release_candidate_gate.py timed out under external 20s timeout during audit; the package contains existing failed gate results.
root_cause: Aggregate gate lacks bounded child-process stop law/structured timeout reporting or performs slow work without progress receipts.
fix: Each child validation must have per-command timeout and structured timeout result. Aggregate must never hang; it returns failed with timeout artifact.
validation: Run gate under 20s/60s timeout on fresh package; it returns JSON failure/pass, never hangs.

evidence: scripts/audit_tauri_security.py failed with dialog:allow-save not justified by current frontend usage.
root_cause: Either Tauri permission surface is wider than proven usage or the audit script is stale relative to export UI. In both cases, current security proof is failing.
fix: Inventory all dialog save/open calls. Remove unjustified permissions or update validator with exact frontend evidence; no broad allow without path/operation rationale.
validation: audit_tauri_security.py passes and emits permission-to-callsite mapping.

evidence: Report/findings show rust/node/git expected files not packaged: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, README, LICENSE, package.json, .gitignore at archive root.
root_cause: Archive root and package profile disagree about what the project root is.
fix: Make packager aware of app root vs archive root. Expected file checks should evaluate Gloss root, not /Coding root, or package should be rooted at Gloss.
validation: Expected-file warnings disappear or are explicitly scoped to Gloss root.

evidence: Findings warn secret-like content in AGENT-SYSTEM.md, ollama_relevant_lines.txt, and ollama.rs; also excludes many vendor test cert/private-key fixture paths and the validation gate script.
root_cause: Secret scanner mixes real secret risk, test fixtures, vendor fixtures, and script names without classification.
fix: Classify secret findings into real secret, test fixture, vendor fixture, validation script false positive. Redact real secrets; allow/manifest known fixtures by digest.
validation: Secret scan output has zero unclassified findings and no active validation script excluded.

evidence: cargo/rustc were unavailable in this sandbox, so Rust checks could not be independently verified here.
root_cause: Current audit environment cannot execute Rust validation; prior receipts must not be treated as fresh proof.
fix: Codex/local run must execute cargo fmt/check/test/clippy on Josh machine and include logs/receipts in a fresh package.
validation: Fresh command receipts for cargo fmt/check/test/clippy with exact toolchain/version and pass/fail/skipped reasons.
